data.one_liner: Detect crashes and anomalies on‑device using accelerometer/gyroscope data and a TFLite model.
data.what_it_does: The package continuously reads sensor telemetry, runs an on‑device TensorFlow Lite model, and emits a CrashEvent stream when a crash is inferred. It also provides configurable thresholds and cooldown handling.
use_when: You need zero‑latency crash detection that works without network connectivity
Your app must run entirely offline for safety‑critical scenarios
You want a ready‑made headless engine to plug into your own UI or emergency workflow
avoid_when: You rely on cloud‑based analytics or remote model updates
Precise crash classification requires more sensors than accelerometer/gyroscope
You need a full safety system with UI components built‑in
strengths: 100 % offline inference with no network dependency
Highly configurable thresholds and cooldown logic
Simple three‑line integration and stream API
weaknesses: Limited to accelerometer and gyroscope data; may produce false positives on varied hardware
No built‑in UI or emergency action handling – you must implement it
data.setup_notes: Add sensors_plus and tflite_flutter dependencies (already included). Request sensor permissions on Android/iOS if required by the platform.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level TFLite inference; you can build a custom detection pipeline if you need full control
